pinterest.description: Before moving sensitive notes into Gemini Notebook, decide what data can go in, who can approve uploads, and what must stay human-controlled. The benefit is simpler risk review before a tool that can execute code and sync across Gemini and Search gets your data. Save this checklist, and comment with one rule your team uses.
pinterest.title: Checklist before you upload notes to Gemini Notebook
